architecture.mechanism: Three-arm differential observability using a witness-ratio guard to distinguish reference contamination from test fouling
architecture.intervention: Install a third parallel RO membrane cartridge (witness arm) in the SWRO feed train and configure the control system to continuously monitor the witness-ratio guard (τref > 0.03 threshold) to decouple biofouling diagnosis from sensor drift or reference channel contamination
architecture.expected_effect: Accurate isolation of biofilm fouling from reversible concentration polarization, enabling targeted bio-remediation and reducing CIP frequency from 3 weeks to quarterly intervals while preventing false-positive chemical cleanings
architecture.falsification_test: Introduce controlled 10% partial biofouling on the reference arm while monitoring the test arm; if the system maintains a 7.72% or lower estimation error and does not trigger a false CIP alarm, the mechanism is valid; if error approaches 71.17% or a cleaning is falsely triggered, the mechanism fails

challenge.kill_reason: all deterministic checks passed; the adversarial gauntlet's objections are ESCALATED (uncalibrated attacker, Art. L) and ride the record for adjudication
